text:
Mia CSM: Heads-up — Saltbox (Alex) just flagged a new intake: 'Ops Insights'. They want Redwood to handle near-real-time summarization + embeddings for alerting and investigator workflows. Planning across 3 squads, estimated ~5k qps peak. Need to assess onboarding timeline and renewal/capacity risk.
Alex (Saltbox): Yep. Pilot will start with one squad then expand. Primary workload is realtime single-turn summarization and embedding lookups; occasional batch backfills. Latency budget ~2-3s.
Jordan SE: Noted. @Mia CSM can you confirm expected token distribution and average sequence length? Also are they ok with Hosted + VPC peering or do they require Private?
Mia CSM: Alex says Hosted with VPC peering preferred, but open to Private if latency/cost demands it. Token distro: mostly short (150-300 tokens), spikes up to ~1k for some transcripts.
Priya Prod: From product side we should recommend model variants: a quantized 8-bit candidate for cheap fast paths, and a higher-fidelity float model for fallback. I'll assemble a short doc.
Jordan SE: Good. I'll sketch a capacity plan. For 5k qps realtime we likely need reserved pools + intelligent routing to avoid noisy neighbors. @infra-bot can you stand up a staging pool we can load-test? :eyes:
infra-bot: Provision request received: staging-pool-4721. ETA ~2 hours. Will post logs once ready.
Alex (Saltbox): Also need per-route cost telemetry for internal chargebacks. Can we show a sample dashboard during pilot?
Mia CSM: I'll loop in billing. @Priya Prod — can you drop the recommendation doc and onboarding checklist link here?
Priya Prod: Uploaded internal playbook: https://redwood.internal/docs/saltbox-ops-pilot. Includes model suggestions, quantization matrix, and evaluation checklist.
Jordan SE: Next steps: 1) CSM to schedule kickoff with Saltbox 2) SE to run loadgen on staging pool and collect latency/cost metrics 3) Product to finalize model/quantization recs 4) Billing to prepare cost estimate for projected QPS. I can own loadgen + initial perf report. Target pilot signoff in ~3 weeks? :calendar:
Mia CSM: Sounds good — booking kickoff for Tue 10am PT, invite sent to Alex, Jordan, Priya.
Alex (Saltbox): Confirmed. Appreciate quick response from the team. We'll bring sample transcripts and expected traffic patterns to the kickoff.
